title: BUG NSv3 does not do total synchronization
symptom: Total synchronization with NS using NSv3 requires multiple attempts, and when it starts it stops partway (stopped at the 12th day when today is the 18th). After clearing database and tapping Total sync, nothing happens.
evidence_quote: Just tested. Cleared db for data over 3 months (minor bug : no message telling that it has been done) then tapped Total sync. Got the alert telling that it might take a long time. OKed. Nothing happened.
